title: corpus-nz-hathi: NZ Parliamentary Debates (1854-1990) from HathiTrust
description: A dataset of 510 volumes of New Zealand Parliamentary Debates (Hansard) spanning 1854 to 1990, sourced from the HathiTrust Digital Library (Collection ID 71329709). Contains full-text OCR of parliamentary proceedings, volume-level metadata, and provenance information for NLP research, legal analysis, and historical text mining.
notes: Volume count: 510. Date range: 1854-1990. Rights status: Primarily public domain (pd).
method: Volumes were discovered by filtering HathiFile dumps for Collection ID 71329709. Each matching volume was parsed into a structured record with year extraction from imprint/title. Volume content was downloaded from HathiTrust, verified via SHA-256 checksums, and organized into Parquet-based metadata tables. The dataset is validated against JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 and synced to Hugging Face Hub via GitHub Actions.
